about: Registered 6 Nov 2026: does the live recipe's trainer data help on days where the trainer is the trainer at the time? GBGB serves each dog's CURRENT trainer on past results (greyhound/pit/core.py FRESH_DAYS), so the history the model trains on attributes a moved dog's old runs to its new yard; the days the nightly fetch read at the time (from about 3 Oct 2026) carry the trainer of the day. The test is those days only (from 2026-10-06). Experiments: the live recipe, and the same without every trainer feature (trainer_win and its race-relative forms, trainer_ae, the intent block ti_). Decision fixed now: if the version without trainer features is no worse on both targets (its paired loss not above the baseline's at the 90% bound), the owner is advised to drop them until the trainer history is rebuilt point-in-time.
